paite: Siampu Lianpen peuhmah mihingte sik-le-tang akhelhnate ziak a thilpiak leh kithoihnate Pathian kiang a lankhawm ding a mihing lak a kipan telkhiak leh mihingte a dia Pathian seh ahi uhi.
heading: Siampu lian Nasep
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

paite: Huaite'n amau ngei leng hatlouhna a tuam a om sam ahih ziak un, bangmah theiloute leh lamhaihte tung ah zahngaihna anei thei uhi.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

paite: Huaiziaktak in mite a ding a alatsak bang un, amau a ding ngei leng khelhnate ziak in lan lou thei lou ahi uhi.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

paite: Huan huai pahtawina Aaron bang a Pathian sap ahih ngal kei uleh kuamah amau akipe ngei kei uhi.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

paite: Huchibang in Khrist leng siampu lianpen a bawl ding in amah akihih thupi kei a, "Nang zaw ka Tapa na hi a, tuni in ka hon neikhia hi," chi a akiang a genpa'n ahih thupizawta hi.
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

paite: Mun dang a agen bang in; "Nang zaw, Melkizedek omdan bang a tangtawn siampu na hi,” achi hi.
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

paite: Ama'n sa aput lai nite in, sihna lak a amah hondam theipa kiang ah nakpitak a kikou leh khitui ke kawm in thumnate leh ngetnate alan a, akihtakdan asiam zel ziak in ngaihkhiak in a-om hi.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

paite: Tapa hilhial himahleh athilthuakte ah thuman azil hi.
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

paite: Huchi in hihbukim a hong om in, athumang peuhmahte a ding in tangtawn a hotdamna bulpi ahong hita hi.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

paite: Melkizedek omdan bang a siampu lianpen in Pathian in abawlta hi.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

paite: Huai mi tanchin ahihleh gen ding tampi i nei ua, genchet leng ahaksa; na bil uh angon tak ziak in.
heading: Ginna Tawpsan Lou Dia Thuhilhna
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

paite: Ahun thu ngaihtuah in zaw heutu hi khinta hial le uchin kilawm hiven, Pathian thubulte hilh kiphamoh nawn na hi ve ua, an gum hilou nawitui kiphamoh na hong hita uhi;
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

paite: nawitui ne peuhmah in diktatna thu ah theihna anei kei ua, naungek ahih ziak un.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

paite: An gum piching a ding ahi, huaite'n azat gige ziak un sia-le-pha theichian ding in atheihtheihnate uh asin zongsangta uhi.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
